basic_details.job_title: IISER Pune Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Senior Project Associate / Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune (IISER Pune) Senior Project Associate / Project Assistant Notification 2026 has been released on the official website www.iiserpune.ac.in. A total of 3 vacancies have been announced through the IISER Pune Recruitment 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. in Physics / Chemistry / Materials Science or related areas, M.Sc. in Physics / Chemistry / Materials Science, B.E. / B.Tech. in Materials Science / Chemical Engineering, B.Sc. in Physics / Chemistry or related areas with 1 year of work experience
qualification.details: Senior Project Associate: Ph.D. in Physics / Chemistry / Materials Science or related areas. Candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis in the area of Energy Storage may also apply. Project Assistant: M.Sc. in Physics / Chemistry / Materials Science OR B.E. / B.Tech. in Materials Science / Chemical Engineering OR B.Sc. in Physics / Chemistry or related areas with 1 year of work experience.

selection_process: Online Interview via Zoom Document Verification
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IISER Pune Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IISER Pune Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Senior Project Associate / Project Assistant posts is 08 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Senior Project Associate and Project Assistant in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Project Assistant position, candidates need an M.Sc. in Physics / Chemistry / Materials Science, or a B.E. / B.Tech. in Materials Science / Chemical Engineering, or a B.Sc. in Physics / Chemistry with at least 1 year of relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The Senior Project Associate will receive a salary of Rs. 57,000 plus 30% House Rent Allowance per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply by sending their complete application and required documents via email.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview conducted via Zoom, followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the advertised positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Senior Project Associate and Project Assistant are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article.

faq.question: Q10. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune (IISER Pune).
